blind.why: AK 30-shot spray in bullet degrees (shots/critic-tagger/r2pair1.png). The reference reads as a learnable shape: it climbs with a slight right drift to bullet 8, makes one decisive left hook (bullets 10-15), then sweeps right. Ours climbs dead straight, makes a weak left hook (-2.7 deg), sweeps right, then makes its biggest move, a -4.2 deg left swing at bullets 21-26. It also keeps climbing about 3 deg after bullet 10, and roughly 1 deg of shot-to-shot jitter turns the top of the spray into a scribble.

AK inaccuracy after a full-speed strafe (r2pair2.png). Effectively a coin-flip: counter-strafing is accurate at about 80 ms in both, and releasing the key is accurate at 200-240 ms in both. I leaned toward A only for its slightly smoother decay.

Firing frame on a live map against CS2 t1_020 (r2pair3.png). The kill feedback is clear on both sides, but ours is cluttered mid-fight: the ROUND banner and an 'E SWAP FOR PIP' prompt sit over the target, and a large muzzle star covers the right third of the screen. Mostly HUD/VFX, but it is what the gun feels like.

biggest_gap: The AK (Arc) spray shape does not match CS2's signature, and its top half is hard to learn. Repro: ?test=1&seed=1&scene=range&bay=wall&tagger=arc, hold fire for 30 shots. The pattern keys in taggers.js:48 go straight up to bullet 9 (x within 0.55 deg), make a small left hook (-2.7 deg at bullet 13), swing right (+3.3 at 18), then make the largest move of the spray, -4.2 deg left at bullets 22-24. They also keep climbing from 9.9 to 13.0 deg between bullets 10 and 29. Measured fire-accumulation noise adds about 1 deg shot-to-shot on top. CS2's AK drifts about +1.5 deg right during bullets 5-8, then makes its largest horizontal move, a sharp left hook to about -4.5 deg by bullet 14. It then sweeps right to about +3 deg by bullet 19 and wanders within ±2 deg while staying nearly flat in height (less than 1.5 deg of extra climb after bullet 10). Re-key the AK, and the M4 the same way, and halve the late-spray noise so the hook is visible on the wall.
other_gaps: AWP (Lance) quick-scope has no penalty. Inaccuracy is 0.03 deg 20 ms after RMB (it is 4.0 deg unscoped), so instant flick-scope shots are perfect. In CS2, a shot fired before the zoom settles still carries a large share of the unscoped inaccuracy.
Judge (Desert Eagle) uses 63 damage, the CS:GO value; CS2 uses 53. At 15 m that gives 49 body damage instead of about 41, which changes 3-tap ranges. Storm (Negev) fires at 1000 rpm; CS2 is 800.
Damage is refused during roundEnd. CS2 allows exit frags, so hunting players who are saving after the round is decided is part of CS. Make this a deliberate, documented design choice.
Scope zoom FOV is about 47 and about 12 (CS2 AWP: 40 and 10). The value read 20 ms after RMB is presumably mid-transition, so check the settled value.
Twin (2-round burst Dual Berettas) and Halo (1000 rpm 3-round burst AUG) diverge from their CS2 archetypes. The design allows it, but it hurts CS literacy.
bugs: CROSS-PIECE, most severe: the local player cannot shift-walk or crouch-walk. On the real map (?test=1&match=1&phase=live) and in the range, holding walk+forward or crouch+forward gives wishSpeed 3.22 / 2.11 but L.vel = 0 and only about 0.2 m/s of drift (src/player/simulate.js ground accel/friction). The accuracy model's shift-walk and crouch-walk accuracy states are therefore unreachable. Scoped-AWP forward movement is also 0.

weapon:fire hit[] entries for open-air misses still carry actor = the shooter (core.js:494, e.g. scatter pellets through glass give '-:SELF'). This breaks the documented contract, where actor is the hit actor, and any consumer can read the entry as a self-hit.
On tag-out, the victim drops both the primary and then the sidearm in sequence (drop:arc, switch:pip, drop:pip). CS2 drops only the best gun. Afterwards inventory.current = 2 points at an empty slot.
strengths: Damage, armour, helmet, hitgroups and falloff are within 1 HP of CS2 for every archetype. Live bot fights logged correct numbers: Twin 0.75 falloff, Judge 0.81, Arc 0.98, USP one-tap heads at 10 m, stomach 1.25x. Inaccuracy tables are now CS2-real: AK 0.40 deg standing, 10.4 running, 0.30 crouched. Air inaccuracy scales with vertical speed (apex-accurate, as in CS), and landing has a penalty that decays. Counter-strafe reaches accuracy in about 80 ms against about 230 ms for releasing the key. Movement speed per weapon is right (Negev 0.625x, AWP 0.83x). Spray is bit-identical across page loads. Fire rates, bolt 1.47 s, 2- and 3-round bursts, shell reload, reload blocked while firing, E swap-pickup and G drop all work. Wood and glass wallbangs carry wallbang/through flags and stone blocks shots. No damage was applied outside scoring phases across a full bot round. Zero console errors.
